content: Please use this page to input board review questions into the designated board review database. Select all applicable categories that the question pertains to by clicking on the corresponding options. Indicate the difficulty level of the question by selecting the appropriate radio button. Enter the exact title of the WikiDoc page(s) associated with the board review question. Provide the patient history or background information by typing or pasting it into the designated text box. Enter the board review question in the specified text box. Input the answer choices as follows: Type answer A in the corresponding box. Type answer B in the corresponding box. Type answer C in the corresponding box. Type answer D in the corresponding box. Type answer E in the corresponding box. Specify the correct answer by typing the corresponding letter (A, B, C, D, or E) in the designated box. If you wish to include an image in your question, upload a file in jpg, gif, png, or svg format. To upload images, use the following options: Upload Image 1 by clicking the provided link. Upload Image 2 by clicking the provided link. Upload Image 3 by clicking the provided link. If you wish to include flash video in your question, upload the flash video file. To upload videos, use the following options: Upload Video 1 by clicking the provided link. Upload Video 2 by clicking the provided link. Upload Video 3 by clicking the provided link.
